system.description:
As a prerequisite to this jutsu you must have the Kujaku Mode active. With your tail feathers pointed skyward, you gather a mass amount of star chakra above you. This star chakra radiates before lowering down onto a point you can see within range, and expands its light filling a 40-Foot radius.

You may select creatures to exclude from the effects of this jutsu.

For the duration, all other creatures that begin their turn in the affected area or enter it for the first time must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure they gain 1 rank of Star Sickness and rank of Sealed.

If a creature fails this jutsu’s saving throw a second time within the same duration, it also becomes Blinded for the duration. If a creature fails this jutsu’s saving throw a third time within the same duration, it also gains 2 ranks of Exhaustion. Creatures that fail this saving throw a fourth or more times within the same duration, it gains an additional 2 ranks of Exhaustion for each failure.

Irradiated: You can treat each failure as if they failed this jutsu’s saving throw twice, for the purposes of determining which effects apply to them.
